name: LangGraph Agent Implementation
description: Rules for implementing the LangGraph agent with Gemini 2.5 Flash

rules.description: Multi-server client setup for MCP tools

create_agent.description: Template for creating a basic LangGraph agent
create_agent.code:
from langgraph.prebuilt import create_react_agent
from langchain_mcp_adapters.client import MultiServerMCPClient
from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI

model = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI(model="gemini-2.5-flash", google_api_key=api_key)
async with MultiServerMCPClient(servers_config) as client:
    tools = client.get_tools()
    agent = create_react_agent(model, tools)
